title: 第20章 机会第1章 马车出逃
content_zh:
第020章 机会
唐安站在蜀山主峰“观天峰”上的大广场内，眼前是一个大大的黑底金字匾额，上书【试剑堂】三个大字，匾额右下还有【追风剑】三个小字。
观天峰，乃是蜀山最高峰，【试剑堂】也是蜀山七绝峰里最大的一个。【试剑堂】占地范围极广，几乎包括了整座观天峰。而且由于成年的内门弟子大多前往世俗之中煅炼，因此，这山上人实在是不多。
唐安一人便占了一间极大的房间。屋内，精美红木桌椅，秀美的字画屏风，一应俱全，比之在外门修炼时，可要舒适了不知道多少倍，不过唐安宁可不要这些东西。
唐安来蜀山是学艺的，可不是来做大少爷享福的！唐安来了内门，可藏锋却不教唐安蜀山武功，也不放他下山。唐安不是傻子，自然知道藏锋的想法。这是要把唐安圈养起来，老死在蜀山！
唐安每日也如在外门修炼时一样，到山谷之中的溪流边上去打熬身体，修炼内功。不过他去修炼通常都是避开其他人，偷偷摸摸的去修炼的。毕竟虽然那些弟子不知道唐安失去内力的事，可话语传到了藏锋的耳里，那唐安立马就会陷入危险。
观天峰下不远处有一座瀑布，飞流直下，水势凶猛。此刻隆冬季节，万里冰封，唯有此处，水流依旧奔腾。
这水流奔腾而下，冲击在岩石之上，让周围也都跟着蒙上了一层白茫茫的雾气。
唐安修炼内气有成，不惧严寒，此刻仅穿一条亵裤，就站在这奔流之下，一拳一拳对着瀑布不停地打出。他的动作很稳定，一拳一拳极为有节奏，不时便能听到“唰”“嘭”的声音。这是拳头刺破空气和水流的两种截然不同的声响。
瀑布的冲击力量极大，唐安的拳头一进入水中，便被瀑布里湍急的水流冲压下来。每一拳，他都努力让自己的速度更快，力量更足，试图让拳头能多抵住一会儿瀑布的冲击。
他没有再选择负重煅炼，因为他发现，那种训练对于筋骨的损伤非常大，而且效果也并不是很好。他可没有再多一枚的培元丹来浪费了。
唐安在这里修炼了已经快半个月了。这半个月来，唐安丝毫没有懈怠。
唐安有了完整的蜀山入门心法，如今已经修炼到了【天人第二重，洗髓伐经】的顶峰。
天已经有些暗了，唐安站在瀑布之下修炼的动作频率也开始慢慢的缓了下来。
一天的修炼，纵使他钢筋铁骨，也有些疲惫了。之所以选在瀑布之下修炼拳法，腿法，是因为这里水流的冲击，能够让他更好的将四肢，腰腹的力量串联起来，再加上内气流转，不停地调节着身体，让他身体里的所有关节组织都组成一个整体，更好的将全身的力量发挥出来。
“好，这是今天的最后一拳了。第一千拳！”
“嘭”的一声，
唐安的拳头重重的打进了瀑布的水流里。这一拳打出，他忽然感觉到全身内气的流转一下子流畅了不少，平时经脉中有些堵塞的地方，此刻居然全都消失不见了。他的手刺进瀑布的水流里，也感觉到不像之前那么艰涩了，他竟然能稍微坚持那么一会儿了！
他心中顿时一愣，忽然大喜，猛地握紧了拳头，再次挥出。他的拳头果然更快了，爆发力也更强了。
他又抬脚。

猛地一踢，
水流顿时“嘭”的一声炸响！
腿劲在瞬间就撕裂了那奔流，水波里发出了一种撕心裂肺的声音，远远传达了出去，极其犀利。
随后，唐安再次踢出三腿。从远处看，只看到唐安的腿影一片翻飞，就像是大刀一样，砍进水里！
他终于踏过了【天人第二重，洗髓伐经】，经脉已经修炼到了完美状态，所有的郁结之处都全都打通了！
之后只要他一直修炼下去，经脉就会在内气的滋养之下，逐渐拓宽，坚韧起来，内气的储存量也会随着功力的增加而深厚起来。
三月之后……
时下已经三月份了，春意隆隆，山巅的积雪融化，瀑布的水流量比三个月前更是大了不少。这四周弥漫的水雾也更加浓厚了，不一会儿，唐安的头发便湿漉漉的了。
三个月来，唐安的身体并没有更加强壮，反而之前那种彪悍的模样却内敛了不少，让他看起来似乎瘦弱了不少。不过这只是表象而已，唐安能感觉到自己身体里蕴含着的强大的爆发力，比之三个月前又上了一个台阶。
进入天人第三重后，唐安感觉到自己的筋骨更加强健了。现在他的身体爆发力，已经超过了800斤。这三个月来，他的力气又大了300斤。已经稳固在了天人第三重了。
天人第三重的极限是1000斤的巨力。按照唐安如今这样的修炼速度，只要再过三个月，他就能突破进入到天人第四重了。这不过才一年时间，他就进入了普通江湖人需要修炼十几年的境界。这速度，实在是匪夷所思！不过这功劳，绝大部分都要归于那小培元丹。不过药物再好，只能为身体打下基础。没有唐安自身高强度的修炼，也不可能让这药效发挥得如此完美！
“天人第三重和天人第四重之间存在的瓶颈，一定是极为巨大的！这瓶颈拦住了大多数人冲击高手的境界。不过我也不用妄自菲薄，我修炼如此努力，厚积薄发，我就不信，这小小的瓶颈会难住我！”
唐安想到这里，手中的剑光忽然爆发出一阵寒光！
剑光一转，唐安的后脚猛的踏在地上，顿时发出“啪”的一声重响，瞬间，他整个人就如离弦之箭一般朝前方冲去。
“猛虎啸岗！”
唐安口中戾啸一声，体内真气鼓荡，灌入手中长剑。
“轰！”
剑劈在巨石之上，顿时就炸开了那块巨石的表面，眼前只看到一阵翻飞的碎石。
待看清楚了，那巨石之上豁然就是一道长长的口子。
可唐安却是摇摇头，显然是很不满意自己的这一剑。

“没有剑法匹配内劲，靠自己修炼，这剑法怎么可能会进步？蜀山不传我剑法秘籍，而系统的任务迟迟不出现，我再在蜀山再待下去，怕是永远也没有出头之日。看来，是时候离开蜀山了。”
而就在这时，唐安忽然听到一阵吵闹声。
“大哥，我是绝不会嫁给那个纨绔的！你们若是再逼我，我大不了一死了之！”那女子原来是王锐指腹为婚的未婚妻子，慕家大小姐，慕虹玉！
“小妹，你要任性到什么时候？你的婚事是爹亲自答应过的！就算那王锐为人不堪，可是我们慕家也绝对不会不讲信用！你和王锐的婚事，在你出生那天就被定下来了，两家都是承认了的，就连蜀山上下都传遍了！若是你要悔婚，你让爹这张老脸往哪里搁？你让我们慕家的脸面又往哪里搁？”
听到这里，唐安的嘴角便扯起了一丝嘲讽。
“原来如此。不过是场政治联姻而已。那王锐是个纨绔又如何？就算他是个傻子。你慕虹玉也得嫁啊。你嫁得又不是他的人，而是他王家的势力！”
那慕虹玉见自己大哥完全不理会自己，还硬是要把自己往死路上逼，当下气的浑身发抖，脱口就道：“我是你的亲妹妹啊……你一口一句为了我们慕家，难道我就是不是慕家的人吗？我没有你这种大哥！爷爷当年逼得姑姑离家出走，十年来都不曾回家看一眼！难道你和爹就要逼得我像姑姑一样，从此有家都不愿回吗？”
那慕家公子一听自己妹妹拿出姑姑的当年来说事，脸色顿时沉了下来，也不顾自己是来劝说自己妹妹的。威吓道：“若是你真的不顾大局，做出像姑姑那样的事来。我们慕家就当没有你这种不孝的女儿，我也当从来没有你这样的妹妹！我话已至此，你自己考虑清楚吧。这王锐，你是嫁也得嫁，若是不嫁，我就叫人绑了你，到时候拜了堂，你就算死了，别人也说不得我们慕家一个不字！”
说完，那男子，大袖一甩，气呼呼的转身离去。而那慕家大小姐，却是面色发白的怔在了原地、她的眼神空洞洞的，充满了绝望，一时间就连原本如雨一般的眼泪都凝住了……
“我是你的亲妹妹啊。你居然为了讨好了一个不成器的废物，就连你妹妹的死活都不管了吗？”
慕虹玉的身体不停地颤抖着，也不知道是因为气愤还是伤心绝望。白玉长剑在她的手中嗡嗡作响，似乎也在为主人而不值。
看着自己哥哥走得越来越远，仿佛从这一刻开始，他就离开了自己的世界。而慕虹玉也已经迈出了她从小就熟悉的世界。她的眼前，似乎只剩下一片黑暗了。或许只有死亡，才是她唯一的出路了吧。至于嫁给王锐，她是死都不愿意的。
“对了！我可以去找姑姑！”
慕虹玉忽然想起了十五年前自己姑姑离家出走的前一夜，似乎将一封信交给了自己。
那一天，天很黑，慕虹玉已经记不清楚姑姑当时的样子了，只是姑姑的话却如暮鼓晨钟一般，每日都在自己的耳畔敲响。原本以为自己永远也不会明白姑姑的话。可是今天，慕虹玉忽然明白了。
“小玉啊，他们都已经疯了！为了自己的路能走得更通畅，迫不及待的就想拿所有的东西出去铺路！钱，人家不缺，势力，人家比我们强。你说，你的爷爷和父亲，会拿什么东西出去呢？现在是我，以后是你！你说是我们慕家的女人太倔强吗？不！是他们这些慕家的男人太没种了！我慕霓裳，绝不会让别人来给我安排命运，哪怕那是我的父亲和哥哥！”
“姑姑说的没错，他们是在拿我的命运为他们自己铺路！可我得到了什么？什么都没有！这样的结果，我绝不接受！”
想到这里，慕虹玉的眼里又冒起了神采，疯狂无比！
可是在唐安看来，她那炽焰一般的光芒，却更像是死灰复燃，在做最后的挣扎！
看着慕虹玉迫不及待的离开，唐安慢慢从土坡后头钻出了身影。

“铺路么？你想离开蜀山，我又何尝不想呢？既然他们连我这么一个小孩都不放心，那么他们对于你，肯定更加不放心了。说不定已经有人监视你，防止你逃跑了。”
不过想到这里，唐安忽然心头猛的一跳：“等等！我似乎哪里想错了！”
唐安脑子忽然闪过一个念头，接着他一刻也停留不住，飞一般的朝那慕虹玉跑去。
“他们以前并没有派人监视她。她的父亲可是清河镇上有头有脸的人物，她的哥哥是蜀山内门弟子。他们一家是蜀山嫡系中的嫡系。这样的一家人，那王瑞图在平常是绝不敢派人去监视她，防止她逃跑的！可是今天之后，就不同了！王瑞图不会，可是不代表她的哥哥不会，她的父亲不会！”
蜀山，唐安已经呆不住了！他若是想走的更远，就必须离开蜀山！
藏锋能保得住他一时，可却保不住他一世！王锋对他做的事，蜀山无法为他讨回公道，他发誓，自己将来一定要亲手来讨回公道！
而那慕虹玉，或许是唐安离开蜀山的唯一机会了！
想到这里，唐安立马回去，将自己的包裹带上，匆匆下山去找慕虹玉了！
content_en:
Chapter 020 Opportunity
Tang An stood in the large square on the "Guantian Peak", the main peak of Shu Mountain. In front of him was a large black-backed gold plaque with the three characters "Testing Sword Hall" and the three small characters "Chasing the Wind Sword" on the lower right side of the plaque.
Guantian Peak is the highest peak in Shu Mountain, and [Jianjian Hall] is also the largest among the seven peaks in Shu Mountain. The [Testing Sword Hall] occupies a very wide area, almost including the entire Guantian Peak. And since most of the adult inner disciples go to the secular world to practice, there are really not many people on this mountain.
Tang An alone occupied a huge room. Inside the house, there are exquisite mahogany tables and chairs, and beautiful calligraphy and painting screens. It is many times more comfortable than when practicing outside, but Tang An would rather not have these things.
Tang An came to Shushan to learn art, not to enjoy the blessings of a young master! Tang An came to the inner sect, but Zang Feng did not teach Tang An Shushan martial arts, nor did he let him go down the mountain. Tang An is not a fool, so he naturally knows what Zang Feng is thinking. This is to keep Tang An in captivity and die of old age in Shushan!
Tang An also went to the stream in the valley to exercise his body and practice his internal strength every day, just like when he was practicing in the outer sect. However, when he goes to practice, he usually avoids other people and practices secretly. After all, although those disciples didn't know about Tang An's loss of internal power, if the words reached Zang Feng's ears, Tang An would be in danger immediately.
Not far from Guantian Peak, there is a waterfall that flows straight down with fierce force. At this moment in the middle of winter, thousands of miles are frozen, but only here, the water is still flowing.
The water rushed down and hit the rocks, causing the surrounding area to be covered with a layer of white mist.
Tang An was successful in cultivating his inner energy and was not afraid of severe cold. He was wearing only a pair of trousers and stood under the rushing water, punching the waterfall continuously. His movements were very steady, and each punch was very rhythmic. From time to time, "swish" and "bang" sounds could be heard. These are two completely different sounds of a fist piercing the air and water.
The impact of the waterfall was so powerful that as soon as Tang An's fist entered the water, it was pushed down by the rapid water in the waterfall. With every punch, he tried to make himself faster and stronger, trying to make his fists withstand the impact of the waterfall for a while longer.
He no longer chose to exercise with weights because he found that that kind of training was very damaging to the muscles and bones, and the effect was not very good. He didn't have one more Yuan Dan to waste.
Tang An has been practicing here for almost half a month. In the past half month, Tang An has not slacked off at all.
Tang An has a complete Shushan introductory mental method, and has now reached the peak of [the second level of heaven and man, cleansing marrow and cutting scriptures].
It was already getting dark, and the frequency of Tang An's movements while standing under the waterfall began to slow down.
After a day of training, even though he was strong and strong, he was still a little tired. The reason why he chose to practice boxing and kicking skills under the waterfall was because the impact of the water here allowed him to better connect the strength of his limbs, waist and abdomen. Coupled with the flow of internal energy, he constantly adjusted his body, allowing all the joint tissues in his body to form a whole, and better exert the power of his whole body.
"Okay, this is the last punch today. The thousandth punch!"
There was a "bang" sound,
Tang An's fist hit hard into the water of the waterfall. With this punch, he suddenly felt that the flow of Qi in his body suddenly became much smoother. All the blockages in his meridians that were usually blocked disappeared at this moment. His hand plunged into the water of the waterfall, and he felt it was not as difficult as before. He was able to hold on for a while!
He was stunned for a moment, suddenly overjoyed, clenched his fist suddenly, and swung it out again. His fists were indeed faster and more explosive.
He lifted his feet again.
A sharp kick,
The water flow suddenly exploded with a "bang" sound!
The leg strength is torn apart in an instantThe rushing water broke apart, and a heart-rending sound came out of the water waves, which was transmitted far away and was extremely sharp.
Later, Tang An kicked out three legs again. Looking from a distance, all I could see was Tang An's legs flying around, like a big knife, cutting into the water!
He finally stepped through the [Second Level of Heavenly Man, Cleansing the Marrow and Cutting the Meridians]. His meridians have been cultivated to a perfect state, and all the stagnations have been cleared!
As long as he continues to practice, the meridians will gradually widen and become stronger under the nourishment of inner energy, and the storage capacity of inner energy will also become deeper as his skill increases.
After March…
It is now March, spring is booming, the snow on the mountain tops has melted, and the flow of water in the waterfall is much greater than three months ago. The mist surrounding the area became thicker, and after a while, Tang An's hair became wet.
In the past three months, Tang An's body has not become stronger. On the contrary, the strong appearance before has become much more restrained, making him look a lot thinner. But this is just an appearance. Tang An can feel the powerful explosive power contained in his body, which has reached a higher level than three months ago.
After entering the third level of heavenly being, Tang An felt that his muscles and bones were stronger. Now his body's explosive strength has exceeded 800 pounds. In the past three months, he has gained another 300 pounds in strength. It has been firmly established in the third level of heavenly being.
The limit of the third level of heavenly being is a huge force of 1,000 kilograms. According to Tang An's current cultivation speed, he will be able to break through to the fourth level of heaven in just three months. In just one year, he has entered a realm where ordinary Jianghu people need to practice for more than ten years. This speed is really incredible! However, most of this credit must be attributed to Xiao Peiyuan Dan. However, no matter how good the medicine is, it can only lay the foundation for the body. Without Tang An's own intense training, it would be impossible for this medicine to be so effective!
"The bottleneck between the third level of Heaven and Human and the fourth level of Heaven and Human must be extremely huge! This bottleneck prevents most people from reaching the realm of masters. But I don't need to belittle myself. I have practiced so hard and accumulated so much. I don't believe that this small bottleneck will hinder me!"
When Tang An thought of this, the sword light in his hand suddenly burst out with a burst of cold light!
As soon as the sword light turned, Tang An's back foot slammed on the ground, and there was a loud "pop" sound. In an instant, his whole body rushed forward like an arrow from a string.
"Tiger Roaring Hill!"
Tang An roared fiercely, and the true energy in his body surged into the sword in his hand.
"Boom!"
The sword struck the boulder and immediately exploded the surface of the boulder. All he saw was a burst of flying rubble.
After seeing it clearly, there was suddenly a long opening on the boulder.
But Tang An shook his head, obviously very dissatisfied with his sword.
"How can I improve my swordsmanship without my swordsmanship matching my internal energy? I can't improve my swordsmanship by practicing on my own. Shushan doesn't teach me the secrets of swordsmanship, and the system tasks haven't appeared yet. If I stay in Shushan any longer, I'm afraid I'll never get ahead. It seems like it's time to leave Shushan."
At this moment, Tang An suddenly heard a noise.
"Brother, I will never marry that dandy! If you force me again, I will die at worst!" That woman turned out to be Wang Rui's fiancée, the eldest daughter of the Mu family, Mu Hongyu!
"Little sister, how long are you going to be willful? Your marriage was promised by your father himself! Even if Wang Rui is a bad person, our Mu family will never be dishonest! Your marriage to Wang Rui was decided on the day you were born. Both families recognized it, and it spread even up and down the Shu Mountain! If you want to regret the marriage, where will you put your father's old face? Where will you put our Mu family's face?"
Hearing this, the corner of Tang An's mouth twitched.ridicule.
"That's it. It's just a political marriage. So what if Wang Rui is a dude? Even if he is a fool. You, Mu Hongyu, have to marry. You are not marrying him, but the power of his Wang family!"
When Mu Hongyu saw that her eldest brother was completely ignoring her and insisting on driving her to death, she was so angry that she trembled and blurted out: "I am your biological sister... You have always been for our Mu family. Do you mean that I am not a member of the Mu family? I don't have an elder brother like you! My grandfather forced my aunt to run away from home and she has not even come home for ten years! Are you and my father going to force me to be like my aunt and never want to go home again?"
When the Mu family master heard that his sister brought out his aunt's past story, his face suddenly darkened, regardless of the fact that he was here to persuade his sister. He threatened: "If you really ignore the overall situation and do something like my aunt, our Mu family will pretend that there is no unfilial daughter like you, and I will pretend that there has never been a sister like you! That's all I have said, you should think about it yourself. This Wang Rui, you have to marry, if you don't marry, I will have you kidnapped. When the time comes, even if you are dead, no one can say anything about our Mu family!"
After saying that, the man swung his sleeves, turned around and left angrily. As for the eldest daughter of the Mu family, her face turned pale and she froze on the spot. Her eyes were hollow and full of despair. For a moment, even her tears that were like rain froze...
"I am your biological sister. Do you actually care about your sister's life and death just to please a worthless loser?"
Mu Hongyu's body kept shaking, and she didn't know whether it was because of anger or sadness and despair. The white jade sword buzzed in her hand, and it seemed that it was not worth it for its master.
Watching his brother walking further and further away, it seemed that from this moment on, he had left his own world. And Mu Hongyu has also stepped out of the world she has been familiar with since she was a child. There seemed to be only darkness left in front of her eyes. Perhaps death is her only way out.
